cameras.name: Galveston Ferry @ Galveston Ferry Landing
cameras.why: Galveston ferry landing. Surge and high water close the landing and stack evacuation traffic on the island.

cameras.name: Galveston Ferry @ HarborSide (N)
cameras.why: Low Harborside approach to the Galveston landing. This street floods before the ferry stops running.

cameras.name: Bolivar Ferry @ French Town Rd.
cameras.why: French Town Road into the Bolivar ferry landing. Peninsula roads overwash in storms.

cameras.name: 45 GULF @ CAUSEWAY (N)
cameras.why: North approach of the IH-45 Galveston Causeway, the low bay crossing onto the island.

cameras.name: NASA 1 @ SH-146
cameras.why: Bayfront arterial in Seabrook where NASA Road 1 meets SH-146 on Galveston Bay, not an IH-45 mainlane.

cameras.name: SH288 @ MacGregor (Brays Bayou)
cameras.why: SH-288 at MacGregor, where the road crosses Brays Bayou near the Medical Center.

cameras.name: W Sam Hou/BW8 @ Buffalo Bayou
cameras.why: Beltway 8 on the west side where it crosses Buffalo Bayou.

cameras.name: Buffalo Speedway@N Braeswood
cameras.why: Street-level camera on low ground beside Brays Bayou, where water stands on the road rather than under a freeway deck.
